_comment: Pinned commit of our own mlx-lm fork's main branch -- installed via 'pip install git+https://github.com/ipsupport-llc/mlx-lm.git@<pinned_ref>'. This app no longer installs anything from PyPI: our fork's main carries real fixes/features PyPI's official mlx-lm doesn't have (NemotronH MTP self-speculative decode, RotatingKVCache quantization, native prism_hadamard_qwen35 support, --model-alias/--kv-bits/api-v0-models/disconnect-safety server flags, muse_glimmer model.-prefixed vision-tower filtering and raw-checkpoint quantization-key normalization, Qwen3.5 image inputs, --mmap-lookup-tables and --lazy-towers for small Macs, Qwen3.5-MoE image inputs, keepalive while a tool call is generated, Qwen3.5 MTP-head self-speculative decoding, a per-request stats log line, the Anthropic Messages API at /v1/messages (Claude Code works with it), the next chat turn prefilled while idle for hybrid models, concurrent requests: batching with a quantized KV cache and speculative requests handed into the batch, right padding kept out of recurrent state in batches, the quantized KV group size fitted to the heads' width, LFM2-VL image inputs, a request's thinking budget, audio input for Gemma 4, an unparsed tool call logged with what the model wrote, cache_store: false for background requests that must not evict, the muse_spark tool parser, an October upstream sync: Mistral4, MiniMax M3, DeepSeek-V4.1, Ling-2.6, nvfp4 MoE global scales, the SSM padding mask in batches, open upstream PRs: batch-decode buffer growth, rotating-cache keep mask, tiled quantized SDPA, fused 4-bit batched matmul, unparsed tool calls kept, /tokenize, ~25 new architectures and 5 tool parsers, the OpenAI Responses API at /v1/responses (Codex CLI works with it)). Bump deliberately via LLMTray's Check for Updates action, not by hand -- see the doc comment on RuntimeManager.swift.
